questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

16 - 4 + 2 × 15 ÷ 5 = 29
questions.solution:
1) ÷ and –

Given expression: 16 - 4 + 2 × 15 ÷ 5 = 29

After changing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 16 ÷ 4 + 2 × 15 – 5

= 4 + 30 – 5

= 34 – 5

= 29 = R.H.S

2) + and ×

Given expression: 16 - 4 + 2 × 15 ÷ 5 = 29

After changing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 16 - 4 × 2 + 15 ÷ 5

= 16 – 8 + 3

= 19 – 8

= 11 ≠ R.H.S

3) × and -

Given expression: 16 - 4 + 2 × 15 ÷ 5 = 29

After changing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 16 × 4 + 2 - 15 ÷ 5

= 64 + 2 – 3

= 66 – 3

= 63 ≠ R.H.S

4) ÷ and ×

Given expression: 16 - 4 + 2 × 15 ÷ 5 = 29

After changing the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 16 - 4 + 2 ÷ 15 × 5

= 16 – 4 + 0.67

= 16.67 – 4

= 12.67 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘**÷ and -**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set of letters that, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series, will complete the letter series.

u _ q _ c _ u r _ z _ n _ r q _ c n

options.text: z n z q u u z
r q n q c u c
r z n q c u z
r z r q c u n

questions.solution:
1) z n z q u u z

u _ q _ c _ u r _ z _ n _ r q _ c n

After filling the gaps by the letters in the given option, we get:

u **z** q **n** c **z /** u r **q** z **u** n / **u** r q **z** n

No particular pattern of letters is repeated when the series is divided into three equal parts.

2) r q n q c u c

u _ q _ c _ u r _ z _ n _ r q _ c n

After filling the gaps by the letters in the given option, we get:

u **r** q **q** c **n /** u r **q** z **c** n / **u** r q **c** c n

No particular pattern of letters is repeated when the series is divided into three equal parts.

3) r z n q c u z

u _ q _ c _ u r _ z _ n _ r q _ c n

After filling the gaps by the letters in the given option, we get:

u **r** q **z** c **n** / u r **q** z **c** n / **u** r q **z** c n

A particular pattern of letters is repeated when the series is divided into three equal parts.

4) r z r q c u n

u _ q _ c _ u r _ z _ n _ r q _ c n

After filling the gaps by the letters in the given option, we get:

u **r** q **z** c **r / ** u r **q** z **c** n / **u** r q **n** c n

No particular pattern of letters is repeated when the series is divided into three equal parts.

Hence, ‘**r z r q c u n’** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All threads are needles.

Some needles are brushes.

All needles are cupboards.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some brushes are cupboards.

II. All threads are cupboards.

III. All brushes are threads.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5560c3938637e957ea11b7041ba43ea6cc7913394a874df2f648c2683bbe2982.png] 

I. Some brushes are cupboards. → True (As, Some needles are brushes and All needles are cupboards → Some brushes are cupboards)

II. All threads are cupboards. → True (As, All threads are needles and All needles are cupboards → All threads are cupboards)

III. All brushes are threads. → False (As, All threads are needles and Some needles are brushes → Some brushes are threads)

Hence, **only conclusions I and II follow**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

20 : 440 :: 15 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

20 : 440 → 20 : 20² + 20 × 2

Similarly,

15 : ? → 15 : 152 + 15 × 2

=> ? = 225 + 30

=> ? = 255

Hence, ‘**255’** is the correct answer.
